decision: NX-028 D1/D2 (owner 2026-10-10, all as recommended): the owner workbench is its own browser business application; enterprise members are existing browser Humans written by trusted configuration only (no self-registration); a customer principal never holds a workbench grant. A role is a set of Action grants, compiled per member by nexloop_eios.workbench_roles and applied through trusted configuration (0050); the member list is private deployment data and never part of this file. Releasing a contact restriction (ADR-023 §2.4), cancelling a commitment, marking a communication commitment and goals/metrics/budget/pause stay owner-only. Actions marked slice 2/3 are declared by those slices; holding a grant before the Action is published grants nothing. v2: slice 3 Action names as published by L4 (nexloop.conversation.takeover/handback, nexloop.message.staff_send), owner and operator. v3 (NX-027, registry 0140): nexloop.commitment.bind_commercial for owner and operator — like attest and condition_met it supplies fulfilment grounds for a commitment, and it cannot fabricate evidence (only verified signed events of the bound reference count, and only for the commitment's own Consumer); nexloop.cost.record owner only — entered costs feed cost metrics and key results, which like goals, metrics and budgets stay with the owner. v4 (NX-029 slice 2, registry 0142): erasing a Consumer or a Message and registering or releasing a retention hold are owner only (irreversible deletion and legal holds stay with the owner, like goals, budgets and contact release). v5: NX-030 alert silencing (nexloop.alert.silence) is owner only. v6 (NX-029 slice 3, 0141): exporting a Consumer is owner only (personal data leaves the system). v7 (NX-035, 0147): opening real dispatch for a scope of a restored database (nexloop.restore.open_scope) is owner only (D8). v8 (AT-043; v7 is NX-035's restore.open_scope, merged first): issuing a catalog incentive (nexloop.incentive.issue) is owner only — it spends the tenant incentive budget, which like goals, metrics and budgets stays with the owner; the budget, the catalog and the per-Consumer limit are still checked at dispatch. v9 (0153, NX-037 prerequisite, dispatcher 2026-10-11): nexloop.real_dispatch.set (open or close real dispatch for the tenant or one of its Actions) is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set. v10 (NX-053, 0154): nexloop.contact_key.revoke (revoke an erased contact key, with a reason) is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set. v11 (G-CONTEXT-STRATEGY, dispatcher 2026-10-15): nexloop.context.strategy.publish (publish a version of how Context is assembled; SQL already refuses every non-human principal) is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set; the stage assembly publishes the relay's strategy with it (nexloop_eios.context_strategy_setup). v13 (NX-028 D2 revision, owner 2026-10-18: the owner may see the knowledge workbench): nexloop.knowledge.read:1 is a read-only Action for the pending-review queue and one pending candidate (0213; the same reads as ontology.schema.review, nothing else); it is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set. The review decisions stay ontology.schema.review, the reviewer's: the owner reads and never decides; the operator gets neither. v20 (outreach slice 6): nexloop.outreach.approve (approve or reject a proactive send whose purpose requires approval; never the requester's own) is granted to the owner role; the plan names no reviewer grant, so another role holding it is a later owner decision. It is not in the owner-only set. v22 (ADR-036, capability gap D-G2; v21 was outreach slice 7, marketing consent): nexloop.object_set.publish (publish the next version of a read-only Object Set) is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set; every member reads and previews Object Sets through nexloop.workbench.read with the per-object READ. v23 (NX-028 D2 revision 2; numbered v18 on its own line, owner 2026-10-20 'reviewer: option A'): the owner also holds ontology.schema.review:1 and decides reviews (approve, merge, reject) in the knowledge workbench, through the same governed Action (rationale required, audited with the owner's principal, expected_revision as before). Reason: the tenant has one member and no reviewer, so the review queue had nobody to decide it. A workbench account holds one role, so the Action is added to the owner role rather than giving the account a second role. The reviewer role is unchanged and can be granted again to separate the duties when a reviewer joins; ontology.schema.review stays outside the owner-only set and the operator still holds neither it nor nexloop.knowledge.read. v24 (NX-039 V4, owner D39-8 2026-10-20): the scope ontology.semantic.release is the pair nexloop.semantic_release.publish and nexloop.semantic_release.rollback, granted to the owner only and in the owner-only set; a reviewer gets them only by a separate owner decision. v25 (NX-039 V6, D39-8): nexloop.semantic_release.stop (stop or resume evolution for one dimension, with a reason) joins publish and rollback as the release scope's third Action: owner only and in the owner-only set. v24 (capability gap P2, 0256): nexloop.object_view.publish (publish the next version of a read-only Object View: the layout of an object's detail) is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set. v29 (NX-041 S5, D5): nexloop.sim_clock.control (move one simulation or shadow world's clock forward: advance, pause, resume, rate) joins sim_world.create and sim_world.delete in the sim_worlds scope: owner only and in the owner-only set. v31 (NX-042 T5, owner D3/D7 2026-10-20): nexloop.consumer_twin.calibrate (calibrate a consumer twin version against real aggregates; a frozen report, and a passed or failed calibration event) is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set (consumer_twins scope). v33 (NX-043 X1, D3): the experiments scope - nexloop.strategy.publish, nexloop.strategy.retire, nexloop.experiment.register, nexloop.experiment.start and nexloop.experiment.stop - is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set. v30 (NX-041 D10 follow-up, dispatcher 2026-10-21): nexloop.sim_world.publish_catalog (copy the real Actions with a stand-in into one active simulation world; definitions only) joins the sim_worlds scope: owner only and in the owner-only set. v37 (NX-056 A1): nexloop.approvals.decide and nexloop.approvals.cancel are granted to the owner role (the first policies name the owner as approver); like nexloop.outreach.approve they are not in the owner-only set, so another approver role is a later owner decision. v38 (NX-056 A5): the owner role holds nexloop.consumer.erase_on_request (confirming a Consumer's own erasure request). v39 (NX-056 A7): the owner role holds nexloop.approvals.solo_mode.set (the single-person mode switch). v37 (NX-058 slice B): nexloop.workbench_member.issue_reset (a one-time reset code for an operator or reviewer; owners are reset with approval) is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set. v38 (NX-058 slice A): nexloop.workbench_member.invite (an operator or reviewer, by a one-time token) and nexloop.workbench_member.revoke_invitation are granted to the owner only and are in the owner-only set. v41 (NX-057 R1/R2): nexloop.remediation.resolve, nexloop.remediation.switch and nexloop.remediation.rule_release form the remediation scope: owner only and in the owner-only set. v41 (NX-058 slice C): nexloop.workbench_member.change_role, suspend, resume and revoke (operators and reviewers only; owners through the owner-only Actions with approval) are granted to the owner only and are in the owner-only set. v43 (NX-058 slice D2): nexloop.workbench_member.promote_owner, demote_owner, suspend_owner, resume_owner and revoke_owner (with another owner's approval, NX-056; never the last active owner) are granted to the owner only and are in the owner-only set. v44 (NX-058 slice D3): nexloop.workbench_member.issue_owner_reset and invite_owner (with another owner's approval, NX-056) are granted to the owner only and are in the owner-only set. v45 (NX-058 slice E): nexloop.workbench_member.erase_member (with another owner's approval, NX-056; revoked members only; irreversible) is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set. v45 (extraction dead letters): the owner role holds nexloop.claim_extraction.dead_letter_resolve:1 (resolving a dead-lettered claim-extraction job, owner only), slice extraction_dead_letters. v47 (NX-058 slice F): nexloop.workbench_member.link_external and unlink_external (single sign-on links of operators and reviewers; owner links wait for an approval policy) are granted to the owner only and are in the owner-only set. v48 (NX-056 budget approval): nexloop.budget.loosen (loosening a budget, with another owner's approval) is granted to the owner only and is in the owner-only set, slice budget_approval.
